findings.description: Reading a plaintext password from a file named 'secret' is insecure.
Sensitive data not cleared from memory.
The code sets CURLOPT_USE_SSL to CURLUSESSL_ALL, then sets CURLOPT_USE_TLS to CURLUSESSL_TRY, which could allow opportunistic TLS and fall back to plaintext if misapplied.
Unchecked return values of curl_easy_setopt can silently leave the connection misconfigured.
On early returns, curl handles may leak.
Missing timeouts can cause hangs and resource exhaustion.
If any header fields (From/To/Subject) were ever built from untrusted input, sanitize CR/LF to prevent SMTP header injection.
